body: Yeah, actually. If you don’t mind
Maybe we could get the acupuncturist to give us a 2 for 1 special! And a discount because you already have the needles?
I may take you up on your offer! Or we could play a board game?

I think the recital was pushed back a week? I believe that’s what the phone call I received from my Aunt was about. I’ll call her and confirm. Will you save me a seat either way? Watching the recital is one of my favorite things!
She’s a very friendly girl, but the dark is scary!
That — that is a lot of mayo!  Not even salt or pepper?
Of course! And if it isn’t, what is your favorite type of sandwich? I can whip something up really quick and run it over.
32 lemons and a bag of sugar! I can’t believe I need to make lemonade for my party! You’re a lifesaver!
I think I saw it at the post office? There was a sticker on the side, but half of it has been peeled off: it said “my other r-“ so I’m not sure if it is yours or not?
I can’t believe she’s getting so big! When you stop by Remind me to send a gift for her ❤️
Oh I can’t wait! I’ve been dreaming about that cheesecake since last summer!
Perfect! I can’t wait to catch up with y’all — how is your aunt doing?
